modalities.evidence: Continuous MEG was recorded with a 200-channel whole-head MEG system

output.population: Thirty-five right-handed participants (13 females, 22 males; mean age 21.7, SD 2.75) with no neurological illness and normal or corrected-to-normal vision
output.summary: Whole-head MEG recorded while Japanese native speakers read newspaper articles word by word, plus T1-weighted structural images. Part of the BCCWJ-Brain collection with matching fMRI and EEG datasets.
